description: Dibaginjigaadeg Anishinaabe Ezhitwaad: A Tribal Climate Adaptation Menu is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Great Lakes Indian Fish and Wildlife Commission. This tool is designed to align with the Adaptation Workbook and adaptation menus published in Forest Adaptation Resources: Climate Change Tools and Approaches for Land Managers. This frequently used resource is also known as the NIACS (Northern Institute of Applied Climate Science) Adaptation Workbook. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
